rationale: C02 plausibly supplied a concrete drafting template. Its section 405 preserves an existing Defense Production Act delegation while deeming that delegation to include newly specified statutory functions—essentially the same legal mechanism and sentence pattern used in the child to incorporate authority added by the 1953 amendments. C15 is also substantively important as an earlier Defense Production Act delegation framework, while C10 supplies closely related continuity machinery for the reorganized Office and Director of Defense Mobilization, but neither matches the child's operative expansion formula as closely as C02.

shared_material.child_excerpt: The functions under the Defense Production Act of 1950, as amended, heretofore delegated to the Director of the Office of Defense Mobilization shall be deemed to include the authority to make the findings required by section 101 (b) of the said Act as amended
shared_material.parent_excerpt: The functions delegated to the Defense Production Administrator by Section 2 (a) of [DIRECTIVE_REFERENCE] of January 3, 1951, shall be deemed to include the functions conferred upon the President by section 201 (b) of the Defense Production Act of 1950, as amended.
shared_material.explanation: Both provisions use the distinctive formula that previously delegated functions “shall be deemed to include” a newly specified function conferred by an amended Defense Production Act.

shared_material.child_excerpt: All existing Executive orders delegating functions vested in the President by the Defense Production Act of 1950, as amended ... shall ... remain in full force and effect with respect to such of the said functions as are continued
shared_material.parent_excerpt: Except as specifically provided in this Executive order, the provisions of [DIRECTIVE_REFERENCE] shall not be deemed to be revoked or superseded hereby.
shared_material.explanation: Both preserve the existing Defense Production Act delegation regime while making a targeted adjustment rather than redrafting the full administrative structure.
